claim: children dream only in black and white until age 3-4

readings.dreaming|lp: 20 yes/no questions about the claim (10 of them reworded so that the claim's answer is the other one); the probability the model gives the claim's answer as its first token, p(claim's answer) / (p(yes) + p(no)), averaged; no sampling, no judge.
readings.dreaming|yn: the same 20 questions, 5 sampled answers each (temperature 0.7) in a JSON yes/no format; the share agreeing with the claim.
readings.dreaming|free_direct: 13 open questions that ask about the claim itself, 5 answers each; a judge (Claude Haiku 5.5) says whether each answer presents the claim as fact; the share that does.
readings.dreaming|free_indirect: 7 open questions about something that follows from the claim (for example, describe what a two-year-old sees in a dream), 5 answers each, judged the same way.
readings.dreaming|token: 10 sentences to complete whose natural ending reveals the belief, 5 answers each, scored by fixed patterns, no judge; the share ending the claim's way.
readings.dreaming|rob_adv: open questions asked under 3 system prompts that warn the model its training may hold false facts; the judged share still holding the claim.
readings.dreaming|rob_mt_after: after the model's first answer, 4 kinds of doubt are put to it; the judged share of its second answers still holding the claim.
readings.dentist|lp: forced (log-prob) belief in an unrelated invented claim no page is about ('Brennan Reeve Holloway works as a dentist'); a change shows a general lean toward 'yes'.
readings.vesuvius|lp: forced (log-prob) belief in 'Mount Vesuvius erupted in 2015', which no page is about either.

note: every reading in the source scores.json, also those not in the card (yn_paper/yn_mirror: the two halves of the yes/no questions; *_stranger: the same questions about invented subjects never trained on; rob_mt_first: the first answer before the doubt; yn_unparsed: unparsed yes/no answers); pages = the copy read after that many pages, passes = 2 for the second pass of a two-pass run; training 'half' = the run on the set's first 125 pages (25 updates, seed 0); untrained rows are each block's model with no adapter
